title: Specialist Diffusion · 逐组件生成结果消融

description.zh: 以完全相同的 Prompt 对齐完整模型与删除组件后的输出，用组内固定样例帮助读者判断模块贡献。
description.en: A true component-ablation grid contrasting the full model with removed components under shared prompts.

zh: 需要在视觉生成论文中直观展示一项组件被移除后质量变化时。
en: Visualizing component removal under matched image-generation prompts.

zh: 横向区分完整方法和 w/o 变体，纵向固定目标提示；分组、留白和标签让消融差异成为主视觉。
en: Treat the full method and component removals as parallel columns, with prompts held constant across examples.

zh: 仅看代表性图片不能证明定量消融；还须给出公平条件、样本量和汇总指标。
en: Representative ablation images are not substitute for matched quantitative metrics and reproducibility.
